HomePage.title: ImuTask
HomePage.subtitle: Your needs, their mission.
HomePage.description: Connecting generations for everyday services, with simplicity, reliability, and security.
HomePage.feature1Desc: Create unique bonds by helping or receiving help from people in your community.
HomePage.feature2Desc: Verified profiles (KYC), secure payments, and reviews to ensure missions are completed with peace of mind.
HomePage.feature3Desc: Easily chat with members via our integrated messaging system to organize mission details.
HomePage.howItWorksDesc: In a few simple steps, find help or offer your skills.
HomePage.step1Desc: Describe your need, location, time slot, and your budget.
HomePage.step2Desc: Motivated young people from your neighborhood offer their help.
HomePage.step3Desc: Accept an offer and pay securely. Funds are held until the mission is completed.
HomePage.readyToStartDesc: Join a caring and supportive community.
